items.title: Bernstein cuts ConocoPhillips and Diamondback ratings as Iran de-escalation looms
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein downgraded ConocoPhillips (NYSE: COP), Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ: FANG) and Devon Energy (NYSE: DVN) to Market-Perform, saying oil stocks may struggle as tensions between the U.S. and Iran ease after the midterm elections.

items.title: Inflation Is Running Above 3%. These 3 Energy Dividend Stocks Can Keep Up.
items.summary: Energy prices drive the inflation consumers feel, but the same commodity swings that protect income can also wipe out a dividend. Three payers sit at different points in the energy chain, and only one has never cut its payout.

items.title: Devon Energy (DVN) Loses 13.4% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why a Trend Reversal May be Around the Corner
items.summary: The heavy selling pressure might have exhausted for Devon Energy (DVN) as it is technically in oversold territory now.
